consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the first set of the show is a standout, particularly praising the energy and performance of 'Lazy Lightning > Supplication' and 'I Just Want to Make Love to You.' While the second set has its moments, it is often viewed as less impressive compared to the first.
standout_songs: I Just Want to Make Love to You
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 35 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the first set and highlighted specific songs, there were also criticisms regarding the overall performance and energy, leading to a mixed sentiment.
